text:
Anna (product): quick sync — we need to decide activation gating for reserved pools before we lock the Q2 launch criteria. TL;DR: ramped headroom vs instant enable, and whether cross-pool spillover should be allowed for the first cohort.
Devin (eng-runtime): +1 on deciding sooner. technical tradeoff: instant enable = simpler routing but big cold-start/queue risk for first spike. ramped headroom lets us warm KV caches and schedule pre-warms.
Sam (eng-sre): from SRE ops perspective ramp window preferred. we avoid paging on day-1. but needs clear automation so customers don't think their capacity is broken.
Carla (eng-platform): Implementation note — we can add an "activation_window" field to pool config. sample idea:
```yaml
pool: customer-reserved
activation_window:
  start: t0
  length_minutes: 30
  headroom_percent: 10
spillover: false
```
Devin (eng-runtime): that YAML looks fine. runtime would respect headroom_percent during admission and gradually increase. question: should the window be time-based or load-threshold based?
Lina (customer-success): customers want predictability. they'd rather see an SLA-aligned activation window (e.g., 30m) and an explicit notification when full capacity available. thresholds are hard to explain to non-technical buyers.
Mike (sales): agreed. also for enterprise deals we can offer a "fast-activation" add-on (instant enable with higher price and dedicated prewarm). good upsell.
Anna (product): options we should vote on: A) default: 30m ramp with 10% headroom, no spillover; B) default: instant enable, but require prepay prewarm for critical customers; C) adaptive: time window + auto-extend if warming metrics not met.
Sam (eng-sre): prefer C if we can implement auto-extend safely. avoids surprises. need circuit breaker to prevent endless extension.
Devin (eng-runtime): auto-extend ok — we'll use warm_progress metric and a max_extend of 60m. also need a fallback: if warm fails, route to compatible hosted model variant and log metric.
Carla (eng-platform): addition: config flag to allow cross-pool spillover for soft-fallbacks only (non-burst traffic). full spillover off by default.
Lina (customer-success): propose communications: in onboarding we show "activation timeline" and include a note in the console for expected warm progress. also add an email template for customers in first 24h.
Mike (sales): can we add a checkbox in the contract: "enable immediate activation (paid)" so sales can sell the add-on?
Anna (product): yes. that'll be Offer X. we need launch gating criteria: 1) activation_window implemented + telemetry dashboards, 2) console UX showing warm progress, 3) docs + CS playbook + contract checkbox, 4) fallback routing policy (hosted variant) tested, 5) smoke run with 3 pilot customers.
Devin (eng-runtime): dev tasks: implement activation_window admission control, warm_progress metric, auto-extend logic with max cap, and fallback routing hooks. estimate 3 sprint work (2 engs).
Carla (eng-platform): platform tasks: console indicator, config schema, UI for contract add-on toggle, and dashboard hooks. estimate 2 sprints (1 frontend, 1 backend).
Sam (eng-sre): ops tasks: runbooks for on-call, alerting thresholds for warm_progress lag, and a stress test scenario for spillover. can do with current oncall roster if devs provide load generator.
Lina (customer-success): we can run 3 pilot customers (legal ok) — will set up playbooks and onboarding checklist.
Anna (product): decision check — we seem to converge on option C (time window + auto-extend + paid instant add-on). any objections?
Mike (sales): no objections. pls add the add-on pricing tier in the contract template.
Devin (eng-runtime): no objections. will shape RFC for admission control.
Carla (eng-platform): fine. will schedule UI spike.
Sam (eng-sre): fine. add circuit breaker numbers to RFC.
ops-bot: Created runbook stub: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-POOL-ACT-1 (ops playbook) :spiral_note_pad:
Anna (product): next steps: Devin to draft RFC with config schema + metrics by EOD Thu, Carla to file UI ticket, Sam to draft runbook template, Lina to line up pilots, Mike to prepare contract language. I'll collect and set a decision vote on Monday. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
